env.name: TRUSTSCORE_API_URL
env.description: Base URL of the TrustScore registry. Defaults to the public production API; override only for a self-hosted or staging instance.

env.name: TRUSTSCORE_AGENT_DID
env.description: Optional stable agent DID used when submitting ratings. If omitted, a local anonymous DID is generated and persisted on first use.
